weighted_density.scope: Moment inequalities and finite charging, not prime-weight construction or asymptotics.

smooth_profiles.scope: Numerical quadrature of explicit smooth compact profiles; no sieve estimates.

cyclotomic_units.scope: Unit differences in three cyclotomic rings. Finite generation of all number-field units and the uniform root field are proved symbolically, not computed here.

two_flags.scope: Split rank-one blocks with compatible graded maps; not reconstruction of arbitrary flag families or seam equations.

shared_conditioning.scope: Independent uniformly sampled coordinate sets; finite entropies do not verify the source coverage schedule.

periodic_components.scope: All period-2 and period-3 nearest-neighbor patterns, with exact lift-cycle detection. Does not construct Gaussian-prime obstructions.

normalizer_extension.scope: Finite wreath-product model verifies unique implementation and nontrivial other-kernel image; no profinite reconstruction theorem checked.

simultaneous_power_separation.scope: Five exact residue-field examples with overlapping prime sets; not infinitude, Kummer independence or Chebotarev.

limitations: Finite identities and models support selected mechanisms only. No full headline theorem or Lean proof build is certified.
